profile.headline: Senior Backend / Infrastructure Engineer | Distributed Systems | AWS | Data Platforms & Scalable Backend Architecture
profile.summary:
Senior backend engineer with 9+ years of experience building distributed systems and data platforms across healthcare and enterprise environments.

 

I focus on designing scalable backend services, distributed data pipelines, and resilient cloud infrastructure that support complex, high-volume workloads.

 

My work often sits at the intersection of data engineering, backend architecture, and domain-driven systems, translating complex requirements into reliable production platforms.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Platform/ Infrastructure
positions.description:
• Designed and built distributed data pipelines processing large-scale genomic datasets using
AWS and containerized microservices.
• Redesigned CI/CD pipelines and build infrastructure for genomic data platform releases, reducing
production roll-up build time by ~85% (1 week → ~1 day).
• Designed and implemented backend APIs and microservices for a cloud-based genomic data
platform supporting clinical research and large-scale bioinformatics workflows.
positions.insights: Large Scale Development, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +2 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer IV
positions.description:
• Developed an AI-driven patient summary platform using OCR and NLP to extract insights from surgical pathology reports, reducing oncologists’ manual data entry and analysis time by ~85%.

• Provisioned development and staging environments using Kubernetes and Terraform, enabling production-like infrastructure for multiple teams and improving environment consistency.

• Re-architected a distributed microservices platform into an event-driven architecture, improving system resiliency by 40% and reducing service downtime by 60% through improved service decoupling and fault isolation.

• Designed and built distributed backend services processing large clinical datasets across multiple microservices supporting mission-critical healthcare workflows.

• Optimized large-scale constraint evaluation pipelines by introducing concurrent processing and improved job orchestration strategies.

• Designed and implemented CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Kubernetes, and AWS, enabling blue-green deployments with zero downtime and reducing deployment failures by ~80%.

• Led modularization of the product suite enabling customizable deployments for enterprise healthcare clients, contributing to a 25% increase in product adoption and sales.
positions.insights: Spring Framework, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +9 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Consultant
positions.description:
• Built enterprise software solutions for clients across multiple industries, focusing on backend services, data integration, and cloud-based architectures.

• Designed and implemented proof-of-concept systems using emerging technologies including OCR and NLP pipelines to extract structured information from unstructured documents.

• Developed client-facing demo platforms to validate feasibility of complex technical solutions under tight timelines and ambiguous requirements.

• Delivered clean system handoffs and technical knowledge transfer to internal teams, enabling continued development and feature expansion.

• Worked closely with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable software systems.
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Software Development and +9 skills

volunteerExperiences.description: • Coached students on Javascript and Computer Science fundamentals.

projects.title: Spotz
projects.description:
Personal parking helper/management application for the city of Berkeley

My contributions include:
• Enabled user authentication and admin authorization for desktop and the mobile application using JWT, OAuth and Bcrypt
• Developed image to text recognition feature using OCR and Regex
• Implemented the donation feature using the Stripe API
• Improved the team’s developer time by utilizing Travis CI to automate the deployment process

https://github.com/SubterraneanTenaciousTasmanians/Spotz/blob/master/screenshot1.png

projects.title: Prsnl
projects.description:
Personal business client relationship management application

My contributions include:
• Enabled Github and Facebook authentication using Node, Express and Passport 
• Created RESTful API endpoints using Node and Express
• Used Google Maps API to calculate the distance between the users and their clients’ geographic coordinates
• Integrated the restaurant search feature using Angular, and the OpenTable API
